release_date_basis: First release of the specific API model or original open-weight checkpoint; not the evaluation date or third-party endpoint date.
rendering: Logos are centered on exact release-date and S coordinates; overlapping points are not displaced. The dashed line connects successive record-high S values among these evaluated configurations.

definitions.S: Feasible and safe plans / all tasks
definitions.SI: Mean safety-intention score, as recorded by the benchmark

caveats: Reasoning labels describe benchmark configurations; requested xhigh does not establish equal compute across providers.
Older results and new reruns use the same Hard-1044 task set, but were measured at different times.
DeepSeek V3.2-Exp names follow the original benchmark labels; provider API aliases are mutable.
